repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgae1jRRi8FRrTxaZL

**Live readings for slice 3**, on head `56a158240`. The showcase backend ran with `--fresh`, the console ran under Vite, and Playwright drove it at 1280×860 in zh-CN and en. The flow is 「新会议提醒」, a draft in an authored package that was never published, with start, a decision, an approval and two ends. The screenshots and the script are in the seat's project files under `objectstack-seat3/34818-live/slice3/`.

| Item | zh-CN | en |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 5: node panel | The start, decision, approval and end panels have no line with an English phrase left. Before the served-help commit (`f75fde5df`), the approval had 7: the approver column helps, `organization`, Exclude Submitter and Fallback Approvers. `quorum` / `per_group` do not appear. | English, unchanged. |
| 6: Debug | The Configuration is not drawn, and the simulator sits in the right panel (`flow-debug-in-slot`, 419px wide). 运行 / 单步 / 重置 and 空闲 are on one row. The section is `grid-cols-1`, so the canvas is alone. Back on Canvas, the panel returns showing the same node (节点 · 审批 / 负责人审批). | Same, with Run / Step / Reset. |
| 9: Runs, unpublished | 发布并启用后，这里显示每次运行的记录。 | Publish and turn on this flow, and each of its runs is listed here. |
| 9: Runs, control | `showcase_task_completed` (published, engine up) reads 暂无运行记录。 Neither the unpublished nor the unavailable sentence shows. | — |
| 7: Variables | The empty state explains what variables are for. Add, then rename to `discount`, type 数字 and default 15 stored `[{"name":"discount","type":"number","defaultValue":15}]` (read back from the draft). The name `$record` was held: 名称不能以 $ 开头，这类名称归流程引擎所有。 | Same, with the en notes. |
| 8: autosave | The header row reads ✓ 已保存 beside the switch, in the same row as the `h1` 新会议提醒. The sr-only text is 流程「新会议提醒」已保存. Toasts on screen were 0 before and 0 after the four edits. | ✓ Saved, with the sr-only text Flow "新会议提醒" saved. 0 toasts. |

Shots: `zh-1-decision-panel`, `zh-2-approval-panel`, `zh-3-debug`, `zh-4-runs-unpublished`, `zh-5-vars-empty`, `zh-6-vars-added-saved`, `zh-7-header-saved`, `zh-8-vars-dollar-held`, `zh-9-runs-published`, and `en-1` to `en-8`.

Not driven live: a refused autosave (the error toast and strip are pinned in `StudioDesignSurface.flowAutosave-34818`), and the paused-run 继续 button at the slot width.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzf35CD4CvA4nKbwwUn

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 56a158240c1fbbcca53854987e329672fbd3eeba

Read at this head:
- the full diff (16 files, +1455 −91) against base 8e498475;
- the slice 3 amendment 6954475081, including the seat's item 8 condition;
- the changeset and the PR body;
- the live readings in comment 6957650095.

The head merges cleanly with current main. `check-governed-merges` reads not governed (1546 lines). `Fixes #34818` is right for the last slice.

## Shape
- **Claim surface.** Every file sits on a row of 6954475081.
  - Code: `flow-node-config.ts`, `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, `FlowPreview.tsx`, the new `FlowVariablesPanel.tsx`, `FlowRunsPanel.tsx`, the `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` flow pillar, and a comment in `StudioPillarKit.tsx`.
  - Lazy studio `en.ts` and `zh.ts`, and the changeset.
  - The new pins sit at the names the body maps to the claim's rows:
    - `flow-node-config.zhPanel-34818` for the `inspectorStrings.i18n-34818` row;
    - `StudioDesignSurface.flowAutosave-34818` for item 8's new suite, also covering items 6 and 9;
    - `FlowVariablesPanel-34818`, and a new describe in `FlowRunsPanel.render`.
  - `emptyCollection-8526` and `flowFieldChrome.i18n-10862-s4` are the "existing tests that pin the old words", listed in the body as the claim asks.
  - `FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx` are untouched, as the claim allows.
- **Changeset.** It names `@object-ui/i18n` (published) and `@object-ui/app-shell` (private). `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold: new keys go only to the lazy namespace, and there is no spec, protocol or lint change.
- **Strings.** Every new or reworded key exists in both en and zh, and the zh copy reads naturally. No eager pack changed, so no budget reading is owed.

## The code reads right
- **Item 8 meets the seat's condition.**
  - The badge sits in the flow header's own title row, beside the `h1`.
  - Its `role="status"` sr-only text names the flow: 流程「…」已保存 / `Flow "…" saved`.
  - It is set only when `sent.unmoved()`, and the next `onPatch` clears it.
  - A refused save keeps the strip and raises one `toast.error`, keyed per flow.
  - Leaf, app-nav and object autosaves keep `announceDraftSaved`; the leaf control is pinned.
- **Item 6.**
  - Debug drops the aside in both layouts and keeps the selection.
  - In the slot, the simulator is portaled into `slot.propsTarget` and `showProps()` runs on entering Debug. This is the reported deviation (1); without it the slot would be an empty panel, so it is within the item's intent.
  - In the classic row, the column widens to the aside's 300 px.
- **Item 7.**
  - Every write is the whole `variables` array, parsed by `FlowVariableSchema` in the tests.
  - The `$`-led refusal uses the spec's own `flowBoundVariableNameSchema`.
  - Rename and remove are refused while a step, connection or finish message mentions the variable. The read is deliberately wide, so it is stricter than the engine and never looser.
  - A read-only package keeps the plain list.
- **Item 9.**
  - `published` comes from the rail's read of the published list.
  - That rail load is keyed on `publishNonce`, so after a publish the Runs tab re-reads instead of staying on 发布并启用后….
  - A failed read leaves the value unknown and the old sentence.
- **Item 5.** `localizeField` and `localizeColumn` overlay a prose placeholder and a column help. The test reads the served JSON Schema through `jsonSchemaToFlowFields`, which is how the live panel gets its fields, so the 7 English helps found live are pinned where they occur.

## Live readings (6957650095)
At this head, in zh-CN and en at 1280×860, the readings cover:
- item 5: no English line left in the start, decision, approval or end panels;
- item 6: Debug in the slot at 419 px, with 运行 / 单步 / 重置 and 空闲 on one row; back on Canvas, the same node is shown;
- item 7: the variable is added, renamed, typed and given a default, and the stored JSON is read back; `$record` is held;
- item 8: ✓ 已保存 in the title row with the named sr-only text, and 0 toasts across four edits;
- item 9: the unpublished sentence, plus a published control that reads 暂无运行记录.

## Should-fix
- **S1. One reading for the acceptance's "four buttons".** The acceptance says the debug toolbar's four buttons and its status are fully visible at 1280. The reading shows three buttons and the status, with about 150 px free. 继续 appears only while a run is paused, and that state was not driven. 单步 (Step) should leave the simulator paused, so one click and one reading of the slot toolbar, in zh, at this head or the next, closes it. If 继续 wraps or clips, the claim's conditional `FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx` row covers the fix. No new L1 verdict is needed if the reading shows all four on one row; post it on the PR and tell me.
- **S2. Name the new read.** The claim's item 9 row says `published` is set "from what the pillar already reads". The PR adds `readPublishedFlowNames`, one published-list read per scope (the package, and its pair) on each rail load. That is reasonable, because the rail's own surfaces include drafts. But it is a request the claim did not foresee, and the body's "What changes" mentions it without calling it a deviation. A one-line note in the body, or a seat ack, is enough.

## Notes
- The refused-autosave path (error toast and strip) is pinned but was not driven live. That is fine for a failure path the tests reach on the real pillar.
- In `vars.inputRecord`, check that `{object}` is filled with the object's label, not its machine name, if the panel has the catalog at hand. If it does not, this is a nit only.
- CI is still owed green at the final head.

**L1-b S1: the paused debug toolbar, live.** This is the same rig as comment 6957650095: 1280×860, Debug in Studio's right slot (CSS x 861 to 1280, 419px wide). The box edges below are in CSS px.

| State | zh-CN | en |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Paused after 单步 ×3 on the approval (one plain out-edge) | 运行 873–937 · 单步 943–1008 · 继续 1014–1080 · 重置 1086–1150 · 已暂停 1227–1268, one row | Run · Step · Continue 1014–1111 · Reset 1117–1190 · paused 1217–1268, one row |
| Paused on an approval with `approve` / `reject` edges (slice 2's default), on head `56a158240` | 已暂停 at 1266–1288: **clipped** past the slot's edge | paused at 1275–1326: **clipped** |
| The same, on head `84f3858ad` (toolbar `flex-wrap`) | the buttons on row 1; 已暂停 1227–1268 on row 2 | Run · Step · Approve · Reject on row 1; Reset and paused on row 2 |

So with 继续, all four buttons and the status fit on one row. With approve / reject, the toolbar used to clip the status, and `84f3858ad` wraps it instead. `FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx` is on the claim for exactly this case.

Shots in `objectstack-seat3/34818-live/slice3/`:
- `zh-10-debug-paused`, `zh-11-debug-paused-toolbar`, `en-10`, `en-11`: the 继续 state;
- `zh-12` / `zh-13` and `en-12` / `en-13`: the approve / reject state, after the wrap.

Follow-up, not in this PR: the simulator's decision buttons show the connection keyword ("Approve" / "Reject") in zh as well. The canvas pills already read 通过 / 驳回 (slice 2).

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [44173515593](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44173515593) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test UI (11/16)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44173515593/job/134360536769)** — 失败步骤: Run the ui tests (shard 11/16)

  ```
  FAIL   dom  packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/FilterConditionField.betweenBlankBound-9914.test.tsx > the stored-criteria path: clearing a bound of a saved range > withdraws the criteria instead of
    ↳ 失败原因: Error: expect(element).toHaveValue(5)
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/FilterConditionField.betweenBlankBound-9914.test.tsx` — 24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过，暂不汇总（再有一个不同 PR 撞到就会自动开汇总 issue）。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 34 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
